text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 22, 2021) for 299 Forman Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (October 22, 2021) for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder No. 21 226345 PRS 00 IV (Exterior Elements), and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 30, 2022.
